assertions.description: The schematic correctly identifies 64 total components including 2 ICs (U1=L7805, A1=Arduino_Nano), 4 capacitors, 10 transistors (5 BUZ11 N-MOSFET TO-220 + 5 BC847 SOT-23), 5 rectifier diodes (SM4001), 5 LEDs, 21 resistors, 12 connectors, 3 mounting holes, and 2 switches. The L7805 is correctly detected as a linear power regulator with +12V input and +5V output. Power rails (+12V, +5V, GND) are correct.

INCORRECT: The assembly_complexity section reports smd_count=51 and tht_count=13. Manual count from footprints gives 35 SMD (4 SMD caps, 5 D_MELF diodes, 5 SOT-23 transistors, 21 R_0603 resistors) and 29 THT (U1 TO-220, 5 BUZ11 TO-220, 5 LED THT, A1 Arduino Nano, 8 terminal blocks, 4 pin headers, 3 mounting holes, 2 switches). The PCB analyzer correctly reports 35 SMD and 26 THT (3 fewer THT because mounting holes are excluded). The schematic assembly analyzer overcounts SMD significantly.
assertions.incorrect_review: rewrite (TH-105, 2026-11-06): smd_count=51 today vs 35 by footprint count (PCB agrees 35); old check passed only because range used value instead of min/max
assertions.migration_note: TH-105: re-anchored to the value the review calls correct (was {"path": "assembly_complexity.smd_count", "op": "range", "value": [30, 40]})

assertions.description: INCORRECT: The design has 5 identical switch channels, each with a BUZ11 MOSFET driving a solenoid load and a BC847 NPN transistor driving a status LED. In the transistor_circuits output, all 5 BUZ11 instances (Q2, Q4, Q6, Q8, Q10) report flyback_diode='D7' and led_driver pointing to D8+R12. This is because the hierarchical schematic was flattened and all channels share net aliases; D7 and D8 belong to one specific channel but the analyzer cannot distinguish per-channel assignments. Each channel has its own dedicated flyback diode and LED, not a shared one.
assertions.migration_note: Path migrated from: signal_analysis.transistor_circuits; TH-109 triage: {"path": "findings", "op": "count_matches", "value": {"flyback_diode": "D7"}, "detector_filter": "detect_transistor_circuits"} -> {"path": "findings", "op": "count_matches", "field": "flyback_diode", "pattern": "^D7$", "detector_filter": "detect_transistor_circuits", "value": 1} (Intent: D7 is the flyback of one channel only, not all five BUZ11. Fails today with 0, but for another reason: the five BUZ11 MOSFETs (Q2/4/6/8/10) are absent from transistor_circuits (only the 5 BC84)
